cmdTranslateNote.message: Translate note to a new file

settingEngineDesc.message: Google is free and needs no account. AI uses your own provider key (BYOK).

settingSourceDesc.message: Language code the text is written in — "auto" detects it.

settingTargetDesc.message: Language the translated text is written in.

settingProviderDesc.message: Built-in providers first, then everything models.dev knows about (refreshed daily).

settingApiKeyDesc.message: Stored locally on this device only.

settingModelDescListed.message: Models models.dev lists for this provider.

settingModelDescMissing.message: No catalogue entry for this provider — enter a model id below.

settingReasoningDesc.message: How much the model may think before answering. Lowest keeps translations fast.

settingReasoningDescNone.message: This model declares no reasoning levels, so the setting has no effect for it.

settingBaseUrlDesc.message: Leave empty to use the provider endpoint shown in the field.

settingLanguageDesc.message: Follows the Obsidian language unless you pick one here.
